note: The shops' X accounts whose calendar pictures x_reader.py reads once a week, on Sunday (docs/README.md, "Calendar pictures on X, read automatically"). Only these accounts are read, to keep the cost down (the owner's choice, 2026-10-25). handle: the account (x.com/<handle>); store: the shop's name as the calendar shows it (as on Tonamel when the shop lists there too); p: prefecture (JIS 1-47); c: city. pages: a shop's own page with its schedule picture, read instead of its X posts (the owner's request, 2026-10-26): page, picture (a piece of the picture's address that finds it on the page), shop (the site's EVENT_SHOPS id), store, p, c; the picture is read again only when it changes.
